vulnerabilities: Seoul metropolitan area (roughly half the national population and economic output) sits within North Korean long-range artillery and short-range missile range, a permanent single-point-of-catastrophic-failure risk
Near-total energy import dependence (LNG, crude) with no meaningful domestic reserves
Concentrated semiconductor manufacturing (Samsung, SK Hynix fabs) creates a high-value target set whose loss would cascade through global electronics supply chains
Aging, rapidly shrinking population — one of the world's lowest fertility rates, compounding long-term conscription and labour-force strain
Heavy trade exposure to both the US and China simultaneously, forcing continual balancing between its security ally and its largest trading partner
strengths: World-leading semiconductor and battery manufacturing base (Samsung, SK Hynix, LG) — a genuine global chokepoint on memory-chip and EV-battery supply
US Combined Forces Command integration and 28,500 forward-deployed US troops provide extended deterrence against North Korea
Advanced domestic defence industry — exports of K9 howitzers, K2 tanks, and FA-50 aircraft to NATO and Asia-Pacific buyers
Dense, hardened underground infrastructure and civil-defence planning built around decades of North Korean threat preparation
